newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FIT-AGAIN PALLISTER READY TO FACE RAPID VIENNA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIT-AGAIN PALLISTER READY TO FACE RAPID VIENNA.

text.p: Manchester United's England defender Gary Pallister is ready to tackle Rapid Vienna in United's vital Champions' League match next Wednesday after making his comeback in the 3-1 victory against Leicester on Saturday.
Pallister, sidelined for five weeks after a knee operation, came through the match with no trouble and said afterwards: "I had no problems with the knee today and hopefully there will be no reaction.
"It was made a little bit easier for me in that Leicester didn't come to win. We weren't tested at all at the back.
"People thought I was struggling against Fenerbahce because of my back but in fact it was my knee that was the problem. After talking it through with a number of people it was decided to operate.
"I feel fine now and it is good to get back in the side and start playing again."
United manager Alex Ferguson was delighted with Pallister's contribution, saying: "He didn't look as though he hadn't played for five weeks."
